title: Uzvar
description: A classic dish from Ukraine, featuring uzvar dried fruit mix, lemon, honey. A practical home-kitchen version with measured step ingredients and clear cooking methods.

steps.instruction: Combine these ingredients in a pot, bring just to a boil and skim any foam. Simmer gently for about 25 minutes to make a flavorful base.
Stir in these seasonings and additions. Taste, adjust the balance and let the dish stand briefly before serving.
Chill briefly if appropriate, garnish with the listed ingredients and serve at the intended temperature.
